scenarios.title: Event form
scenarios.assertion: The seeded event can be opened in the registration UI.

scenarios.title: Registration
scenarios.assertion: A synthetic attendee submission produces the defined result.

scenarios.title: Administrator view
scenarios.assertion: An authorized test administrator can find the selected registration.

scenarios.title: Draft behavior
scenarios.assertion: The chosen draft flow behaves as documented for that form.

scenarios.title: Role boundary
scenarios.assertion: Desired deployment requirement: a regular user cannot access administrator data. Verify real auth setup first; local sample credentials do not prove this.
